note: Shared inputs for the required return (CAPM) of every company. Refresh each January, and sooner if the 10-year bond yield moves by more than 1 point. scripts/reinvestment.py reads this file; never type these figures into an analysis by hand.

bondYield10y.source: Cbonds, yield to maturity on 10-year Sri Lanka government bonds (rupee)
bondYield10y.note: The rupee 10-year yield. Long-run growth must stay below this.

defaultSpread.source: Market-based: Sri Lanka's dollar bond yields (about 3.6-8.4%) against US 10-year Treasuries (about 4.2%), as discussed with the owner on 14 November 2026
defaultSpread.note: Taken out of the bond yield to get a risk-free rate, then scaled by the volatility factor to get the country premium. Damodaran's rating-based spread is the alternative.

matureERP.source: Damodaran, Country Risk 2026 edition: mature-market equity risk premium, July 2026
matureERP.note: The extra return investors want from shares over bonds in a mature market.

volatilityFactor.source: Damodaran: emerging-market equity volatility relative to emerging-market government bonds
volatilityFactor.note: Country premium = default spread x this factor.

taxRate.source: Sri Lanka standard corporate income tax rate
taxRate.note: Used for after-tax cost of debt and interest only when a company's own effective rate isn't recorded.

scenarioSpread.note: Bear required return = base + this; bull = base - this.
